title: Group EMDR for the treatment of patients with complex post-traumatic stress disorder - side effects and autobiographic memory
summary:
In the following study, trauma-confrontative therapy will be carried out in a group for patients with complex post-traumatic stress disorder (cPTSD). A therapy manual by F. Shapiro (Group Traumatic Episode Protocol, G-TEP) will be used for this purpose. The group will take place over 5 sessions, 1/week, after that an individual follow-up session will be conducted with each participant. 
In addition, questionnaires will be used to assess the effects of the treatment and any adverse reactions, as well as to investigate changes in autobiographical memories resulting from trauma-focused therapy.

interventions.name: Trauma confrontative treatment through EMDR in the group with the help of the G-TEP protocol (Group Traumatic Episode Protocol) according to Shapiro. 5 outpatient sessions, 1 individual follow-up contact, with 4-7 patients, 1/week.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Complex Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
Exclusion criteria:
acute suicidal tendencies, substance abuse, psychotic symptoms, individual exclusion criteria, which are asked about in a detailed interview before inclusion in the study (strategies for emotion regulation, self-injurious behavior, dissociations, previous therapeutic experience, medication, outpatient therapeutic connection, etc.)
